gaps: County offices (county clerk, county treasurer, register of deeds and surveyor) in the 70 counties other than Milwaukee and Dane

Each county's board of canvassers canvasses its own offices; the Elections Commission does not publish them. Each county clerk posts the canvass on the county's own site, and those have not been read yet.
County, city, village, town and school district questions outside Dane County, and Milwaukee County's city, village and school questions
Local questions are canvassed by the county where they are voted on; no statewide list of their results exists, and the counties' files have not been read yet.
School district questions: the part of a district outside Dane County
Dane County's canvass counts only its own electors; where a school district reaches into a neighbouring county, that county canvasses the rest, which is not loaded.
The Commission's signed Statements of Canvass
The Commission's results page for this election posts the reports and the summary but no signed statements; the reports' own figures are used.
